heading.en: A business you are born into

hook.en: In many towns there are old family shops run by three generations under one roof. The eldest member runs the show, and a newborn grandchild is already a member of the business.
hook.kn: ಹಲವು ಊರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ತಲೆಮಾರುಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಸೂರಿನಡಿ ನಡೆಸುವ ಹಳೆಯ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳಿವೆ. ಹಿರಿಯ ಸದಸ್ಯ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ ಮೊಮ್ಮಗುವೂ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಸದಸ್ಯ.

objectives.en: Describe the features of a Joint Hindu Family business

narration.en: In many towns there are old family shops run by three generations under one roof. The eldest member runs the show, and a newborn grandchild is already a member of the business.
narration.kn: ಹಲವು ಊರುಗಳಲ್ಲಿ ಮೂರು ತಲೆಮಾರುಗಳು ಒಂದೇ ಸೂರಿನಡಿ ನಡೆಸುವ ಹಳೆಯ ಕುಟುಂಬ ಅಂಗಡಿಗಳಿವೆ. ಹಿರಿಯ ಸದಸ್ಯ ನಡೆಸುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಹೊಸದಾಗಿ ಹುಟ್ಟಿದ ಮೊಮ್ಮಗುವೂ ವ್ಯವಹಾರದ ಸದಸ್ಯ.

body.en: A Joint Hindu Family business is owned and carried on by the members of a Hindu Undivided Family and is governed by the Hindu Succession Act, 1956. Membership is by birth, the Karta manages it and has unlimited liability, while coparceners are liable only to the extent of their share. The business continues even after the death of the Karta.

points.en: Formation: at least two members and ancestral property
Governed by the Hindu Succession Act, 1956

narration.en: A Joint Hindu Family business is owned and carried on by the members of a Hindu Undivided Family and is governed by the Hindu Succession Act, 1956. Membership is by birth, the Karta manages it and has unlimited liability, while coparceners are liable only to the extent of their share. The business continues even after the death of the Karta.
narration.kn: ಹಿಂದೂ ಅವಿಭಕ್ತ ಕುಟುಂಬ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಹಿಂದೂ ಉತ್ತರಾಧಿಕಾರ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 1956ರ ಅಡಿಯಲ್ಲಿದೆ. ಸದಸ್ಯತ್ವ ಹುಟ್ಟಿನಿಂದ; ಕರ್ತನ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ ಅಪರಿಮಿತ, ಇತರ ಸದಸ್ಯರದು ಸೀಮಿತ.

body.en: Merits: effective control by the Karta, continued existence, limited liability of members, and increased loyalty and cooperation. Limitations: limited resources, unlimited liability of the Karta, dominance of the Karta and limited managerial skills. Two systems govern it: Dayabhaga in West Bengal and Mitakshara in the rest of India.

points.en: Merits: effective control, continuity, limited liability of members, loyalty
Limitations: limited resources, Karta's unlimited liability, dominance of Karta, limited skills

narration.en: Merits: effective control by the Karta, continued existence, limited liability of members, and increased loyalty and cooperation. Limitations: limited resources, unlimited liability of the Karta, dominance of the Karta and limited managerial skills. Two systems govern it: Dayabhaga in West Bengal and Mitakshara in the rest of India.
narration.kn: ಪರಿಣಾಮಕಾರಿ ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣ ಮತ್ತು ನಿರಂತರತೆ ಅನುಕೂಲಗಳು; ಸೀಮಿತ ಸಂಪನ್ಮೂಲ ಮತ್ತು ಕರ್ತನ ಪ್ರಾಬಲ್ಯ ಮಿತಿಗಳು.

problem.en: The Joshi family of Hubballi runs a jewellery business managed by Karta Vasant (68); his son Prakash (45) is the next eldest. A creditor's claim of ₹10,00,000 exceeds business assets of ₹7,00,000. Who bears the shortfall, and what happens if Vasant dies?

steps.en: Only the Karta has unlimited liability, so the shortfall can be recovered from Vasant's personal assets.
Other coparceners lose at most their share in the family property.
If Vasant dies, the business continues and the next eldest member, Prakash, becomes the Karta.

answer.en: Vasant (the Karta) bears the ₹3,00,000 shortfall; on his death Prakash becomes Karta

narration.en: Let us work through this case together. The Joshi family of Hubballi runs a jewellery business managed by Karta Vasant (68); his son Prakash (45) is the next eldest. A creditor's claim of ₹10,00,000 exceeds business assets of ₹7,00,000. Who bears the shortfall, and what happens if Vasant dies?
Team quiz. Each team discusses for a moment and gives one answer.
narration.kn: ತಂಡ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ಪ್ರತಿ ತಂಡ ಸ್ವಲ್ಪ ಚರ್ಚಿಸಿ ಒಂದು ಉತ್ತರ ನೀಡಲಿ.

points.en: Membership is by birth; the eldest member, the Karta, manages.
points.kn: ಸದಸ್ಯತ್ವ ಹುಟ್ಟಿನಿಂದ; ಹಿರಿಯ ಸದಸ್ಯ ಕರ್ತ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ.

points.en: The Karta has unlimited liability; coparceners have limited liability.
It continues after the Karta's death.
Governed by the Hindu Succession Act, 1956.

homework.en: Distinguish between the liability of the Karta and the coparceners.

narration.en: Recap. Membership is by birth; the eldest member, the Karta, manages. The Karta has unlimited liability; coparceners have limited liability. It continues after the Karta's death. Governed by the Hindu Succession Act, 1956.
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಸದಸ್ಯತ್ವ ಹುಟ್ಟಿನಿಂದ; ಹಿರಿಯ ಸದಸ್ಯ ಕರ್ತ ನಿರ್ವಹಿಸುತ್ತಾನೆ. ಕರ್ತನಿಗೆ ಅಪರಿಮಿತ ಹೊಣೆಗಾರಿಕೆ; ಸಹಭಾಗಿಗಳಿಗೆ ಸೀಮಿತ. ಕರ್ತನ ಮರಣದ ನಂತರವೂ ವ್ಯವಹಾರ ಮುಂದುವರಿಯುತ್ತದೆ. ಹಿಂದೂ ಉತ್ತರಾಧಿಕಾರ ಕಾಯ್ದೆ 1956 ಅನ್ವಯ.
